evidence_refs: string:Unable to allocate memory for file

preconditions: The MAS archive object must be constructed by sub_55FBE0 (caller 0x0053CBC0 runs constructor before loader) so the magic string at object base and all zeroed fields are in a known state.
sub_55FC40 requires a non-empty filename argument; NULL or an empty first byte returns -1 immediately.
sub_55FC40 expects the opened file to begin with a 12-byte header matching one of the CUBEMAS magic strings (CUBEMAS410, CUBEMAS400, CUBEMAS401); a mismatch is treated as a fatal error.
sub_560230 requires the archive entry count at +0x118 to be greater than zero; an empty table returns -2 without seeking.
sub_5518A0 requires a 52-byte node allocation to succeed and the item initializer sub_5508A0 to return 0 before the node is inserted; both failures take the -1 path.
postconditions: On success sub_55FC40 stores the open file handle at +0x10, reads the 12-byte magic into the object base, reads three 4-byte header fields (+0x114, +0x118, +0x120), computes the data size as (field at +0x118) << 8 into +0x11C, allocates a buffer at +0x128, reads the payload into it, and bumps +0x11C by 24. Returns 0.
On header mismatch, allocation failure, or empty filename sub_55FC40 closes the handle at +0x10, reports via sub_53C590, and returns -1; on total open failure across the search path it returns -2.
On success sub_560230 stores the matched entry index at +0x124 and seeks the handle at +0x10 to (field at +0x11C) + (entry data offset at entry+4) via sub_587F64. Returns 0.

On success sub_5518A0 links the new node into the named list: head pointer at this[70]/+0x118, node prev at +0x2C, node next at +0x30, and stores the inserted (or existing) node through *a2. Returns 0 on insert, -2 on duplicate name, -1 on load failure.
side_effects: sub_55FC40 opens and closes file handles (direct path then each registered search directory in byte_8B5A3C with count dword_8B8E30, stride 0x84) and allocates heap memory via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03).
sub_55FC40 reports errors through sub_53C590 (0x0053C590) with the formatted message buffers.
sub_5518A0 allocates a 52-byte node, calls the item loader sub_5508A0, mutates the caller's named-item list, and on failure or duplicate frees the node via EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf.
sub_560230 changes the read position of the file handle at +0x10 through sub_587F64.
sub_587BCF forwards its pointer argument to sub_58AA6F, releasing the referenced memory.

disputes.description: sub_55FBE0, sub_55FC40 and sub_560230 share layout offsets (handle at +0x10, filename at +0x14, header/size fields at +0x114..+0x128) and sub_55FBE0/sub_55FC40 share the single caller 0x0053CBC0, which suggests one CubeMapMasFileLoader/MAS-archive type. Shared offsets do not by themselves prove a shared type; the identity remains DERIVED.

Offset +0x118 is read as a plain header field in sub_55FC40 (feeds the (field << 8) data-size calculation) and as the entry count in sub_560230's table scan. The roles are consistent with one index semantics but the two 4-byte header fields at +0x114 and +0x120 are read but never used, leaving their meaning unknown.
sub_55FC40 adds 24 to +0x11C after reading the payload; the trailing overhead (+24) and whether +0x11C is a size or a base offset (sub_560230 adds +0x11C to an entry offset) are not fully reconciled.

The packet mixes the MAS-archive loader type (construct/load/index), a caller-side named-item list insertion (sub_5518A0), a no-op destructor stub (sub_57470) and a free shim (sub_587BCF). It is classified as a 'type' contract on the dominant loader evidence; the list/registration side could be argued as a separate lifecycle contract.

unresolved: External contract dependencies cut at the packet frontier, all without in-packet bodies: 0x004B0170 (EmptyStub_0170 behind the EmptyStub_7470 thunk), 0x0053C2A0 (GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 used by the constructor), 0x00550870 (callee of sub_5518A0), 0x00550AC0 (callee of sub_5518A0), 0x00587F64 (file seek used by sub_560230), 0x0058AA6F (underlying free routine behind FreeWrapper_7bcf), 0x0058B050 (CRTStrrchr). Each is a bounded-frontier cut, not evidence the dependency is optional.
The two unused 4-byte header fields read at +0x114 and +0x120 by sub_55FC40 have no known role.
The trailing +24 adjustment applied to +0x11C after the payload read is unexplained.

The identity of the function behind the StructZeroInitWithUnitVector and CallWrapperReturning0 calls in sub_5518A0 (mapped only to the callee set 0x00550870/0x005508A0/0x00550AC0) is not confirmed by the raw source.
The meaning of the a4 flag in sub_5518A0 beyond its low force-insert bit, and the purpose of EmptyStub_7470 being invoked before every FreeWrapper_7bcf call, are unknown.

Deterministic field facts record a deep traversal through this+0x148 (0x30 at two levels) for sub_5518A0, but the raw source only shows the head list at +0x118; the relationship between the two is not established.
The name string stored at named_item_node+0x1C and the object type loaded by sub_5508A0 (a mesh/resource node, per the IR) are not independently evidenced.
The meaning of the zero third argument passed to sub_587F64 in sub_560230 is unknown.
The +0x12C and +0x130 dwords of mas_archive are zeroed by the constructor but never otherwise touched in this packet; their purpose is unknown.
Global 0x005C2D64 (aSS_3) appears in packet architecture evidence but is not visible in any raw source body in this packet; its role is unknown.
sub_587BCF's callee sub_58AA6F is inferred to be a free/delete shim from the wrapper's large cleanup/destructor caller set; exact semantics are not evidenced here.
tests_required: Constructor test: run sub_55FBE0 and assert the object base equals the CUBEMAS410 magic and +0x10, +0x14, +0x114, +0x118, +0x11C, +0x120, +0x124, +0x128, +0x12C, +0x130, +0x0C are zeroed.
Load round-trip: sub_55FC40 against a real CUBEMAS410/400/401 file asserts handle at +0x10 is non-zero, +0x11C == ((field at +0x118) << 8) + 24, buffer at +0x128 contains the payload, return 0.
Magic rejection: a file whose 12-byte header is not a CUBEMAS magic is closed and returns -1.

Search-path fallback: when the direct path open fails, a file found only under one of the byte_8B5A3C search directories (count dword_8B8E30, stride 0x84) is located and loaded; when none exists, returns -2.
Empty-filename guard: sub_55FC40(NULL, "") returns -1 without opening or allocating.

Lookup-and-seek: sub_560230 for a known entry name returns 0, stores the index at +0x124, and sub_587F64 is reached with the computed offset (+0x11C base + entry[+4]); unknown names and an empty table return -2.
List registration: sub_5518A0 inserts a fresh node (head at +0x118, prev/next at +0x2C/+0x30, return 0), returns -2 with the existing node on a duplicate name, and returns -1 when sub_5508A0 fails.
Free path: FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) forwards its argument to sub_58AA6F; EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470) performs no observable work.
